text:
Maya: Heads-up  Catalyst newsletter pulse: 3-email micro-drip tied to the June benchmark release + gated deck. Focus: low-friction CTA, mobile-first, timezone micro-sends.

Owen: Nice. Proposed cohorts: (A) new signups 0-72h, (B) trial users 7-21d, (C) product-engaged (searches, docs hits) last 14d. Also carve out top-accounts for manual outreach.

Farah: Localization: too many variants kills velocity. We'll do 3 locale buckets: en-global, en-apac (AU/NZ/SG), en-in. Use local date formatting and friendly time tokens.

Gina: Creative constraints: single hero, 1-button primary CTA (Book demo), subtle secondary link (Download deck). Provide a dark-mode PNG variant and a tiny GIF (<150KB) for the hero.

Sam: Ops checklist: campaign-runner supports micro-windows. Recommend per-ISP throttle map to avoid queueing: SendGrid 6k/hr, Amazon 4k/hr, MailerX 2k/hr. Canary: 3% global then ramp 10/30/100.

Maya: Experiment idea: dynamic preheader showing a stat for the recipient cohort (e.g., "Median latency 32ms for trialers") vs static preheader. Track lift on CTR and deck downloads.

Owen: I'll own segments + exclusion logic. Important: exclude anyone who got a benchmark invite in last 60 days, unsubscribed, or hard-bounced. Also flag high-risk ISPs for manual throttle.

Farah: Subject test: "New: Redwood benchmark snapshot" vs "How we trimmed inference cost 30%". For en-apac cohort, add emoji variant. We'll run subject A/B only on 10k sample.

Gina: I'll upload assets to drive:/marketing/catalyst-pulse/assets by EOD Mon. Variants: hero-A (stat-forward), hero-B (product-in-use). Mobile previews included.

Sam: Ops config snippet:
```
campaign: catalyst-pulse-v1
canary_pct: 3
ramp: [10,30,100]
isp_throttle: {SendGrid:6000, Amazon:4000, MailerX:2000}
send_windows: {en-global: "09:00-11:00 local", en-apac: "10:00-12:00 local"}
```
I'll translate to campaign-runner YAML and post link.

Maya: Metrics to watch: deliverability (blocks/bounces), open rate, CTR to deck, webinar signups from CTA. If block rate >0.5% in any ISP, pause that ISP and notify deliverability team.

deliverability-bot: Monitor created: catalyst-pulse-deliv (id: dlv_7724). Alert thresholds: hard_bounce>0.2%, spam_complaint>0.05%, block_rate>0.5%.

Owen: Timeline: segments ready Wed AM, copy Wed EOD, assets Tue EOD, canary Thu 07:00 UTC. Will export lists with sample size per subject test.

Farah: Also recommend a fallback alt-text-first template for image-blocking ISPs (text-first with small CTA at top). We should count engagement for those separately.

Gina: Noted. I'll prepare fallback templates and include both in the drive.

Maya: Ownership recap: Owen = segments & exports, Farah = localization & subject tests, Gina = creative & fallback, Sam = ops & throttle config, Maya = metrics/reporting.

Sam: Will post campaign-runner job link once YAML is uploaded.

Maya: Sweet. We meet 24h post-canary to decide ramp. If CTR < baseline -12% or spam complaints > threshold, we'll halt and iterate subject + preheader. :mag_right:
